reply_text:
I saved Ilse's figure in GBrain: Quarrendon Freight Lines has 261 seats for the 2026 renewal. The note includes where it came from (Ilse, #north-team, 2026-10-14).

I also replied to Ilse in the #north-team thread to confirm it's recorded. In the reply I said the previous number on file was 185 seats, from Amendment No. 1 in August 2025, so 261 is now the current count. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so posting it in the team channel was fine.

The brain is set up for keyword search only. It can't spot reworded duplicates, so if someone records this count again in different words, it may be saved twice.
